title: Introducing Taskade App Factory (November 2026)
summary: Taskade App Factory is live. Clone CRMs, dashboards, client portals, and trackers with AI agents and automations built in. Then tell Taskade EVE what to change.
body_markdown:
Taskade App Factory is live at[taskade.com/apps](https://www.taskade.com/apps) . Clone a CRM, a dashboard, a client portal, or a tracker, and it runs in your workspace with AI agents and automations built in. No code. Imagine it. Run it live. Make it yours.


> **TL;DR:**[Taskade App Factory](https://www.taskade.com/apps) is the home for App Kits: live business apps with AI agents and automations that you clone, customize, and share. The new Pro Edition kits come at no extra price on every paid plan. Kits with no price clone free, and Free includes 3 Taskade Genesis apps. Publish your own kit to your creator profile.


## What Is Taskade App Factory?


**Clone Apps. Customize Free.** Every App Kit in Taskade App Factory is a working Taskade Genesis app, not a blank file. Each one brings its projects, AI agents, and automations. Some automations ask you to connect an account or add details after you clone, before they run.


What you can do How it works


**Clone** Pick a kit and copy the whole app into your workspace.


**Customize** Tell Taskade EVE what to change, in plain words.


**Share** Publish your own kit, and others can clone it from your creator profile.


Not sure where to start?[Browse & Clone Community Apps](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/community-gallery) walks through each step.

## How Do You Make an App Kit Yours?


**Your Apps. Fully Connected.** A cloned kit lives in your workspace beside your apps, agents, and automations. Taskade EVE changes it when you ask in plain words, so you do not edit code. The diagram shows the 4 steps, from a browse in Taskade App Factory to an app that runs live in your workspace.


Try one of these after you clone:


- "Rename Clients to Patients and add an insurance field."
- "Email me every Monday with overdue invoices."
- "Use our brand colors and logo."


Your app runs on Workspace DNA: projects hold your data, agents answer, and automations act.[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) explains how the parts feed each other.


## How Do You Publish Your Own App Kit?


**Publish Apps. Get Discovered.** You publish a kit from any Taskade Genesis app in 3 steps. Choose **Free** or **Paid** under **Let others clone** , and the kit shows on your own page on Taskade, like[taskade.com/@john](https://www.taskade.com/@john) . That page shows your apps and your expertise in one place.


1. Open your Taskade Genesis app and choose **Publish** .
2. Open **Let others clone** , then choose **Free** or **Paid** .
3. Add a clear title and description. Your kit goes live right away.


See the top builders in[Explore Top Creators](https://www.taskade.com/apps/creators) , and read[Publish and Clone Your Apps](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/publishing) for every option.


## Start From a Working App


Every app your business runs on is now one click away. Pick one of the 26 kits in this post, clone it, and tell Taskade EVE what to change. Or open Taskade App Factory and browse every kit by category, from CRMs and invoices to client portals and booking.


[Browse App Kits →](https://www.taskade.com/apps) ·[Build with AI →](https://www.taskade.com/create?prompt=Build%20an%20app%20for%20my%20business.%20Ask%20me%20what%20I%20need%2C%20then%20add%20the%20projects%2C%20AI%20agents%20and%20automations.&entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Fai-app-factory)


## Frequently Asked Questions


What is Taskade App Factory?


Taskade App Factory is the gallery of App Kits at taskade.com/apps. Each App Kit is a live Taskade Genesis app with its projects, AI agents, and automations already built in. You clone it, customize it, and share it.


Are App Kits free to clone?


A kit with no price and no PRO badge clones free, on every plan. The Pro Edition kits in this post carry a PRO badge and clone into a workspace on a paid plan, at no extra price. Some creators set a one-time price on their own kits.


What happens when I clone an App Kit?


Taskade copies the whole kit into your workspace: the app, its projects, its AI agents, and its automations. The copy is yours. Change it by hand or ask Taskade EVE in plain words. Your changes do not touch the original kit.


Can I clone an App Kit on the Free plan?


Yes, any kit with no price and no PRO badge. AI agents and AI steps in your copy use AI credits. On Free, you earn free AI credits with referrals and invites, and you can upgrade any time.


How do I publish my own App Kit?


Open your app, choose Publish, then Let others clone, and pick Free or Paid. Your kit shows on your creator profile and in Taskade App Factory.
